notes: Revision B tracks the v0.2 design (one-piece rocker, 3 x 3 keys, 135 x 54 mm Mars-style wheels, optical-breadboard deck, mock MMRTG, printed-in PET-G limit stops).
Quantities are for one passive six-wheel rover and include the stated prototype spares.
Verify all critical dimensions against the linked supplier drawing before ordering.
The two wheel-axle screw sizes are manufacturer-neutral DIN 7984 requirements because supplier stock changes frequently.
No TPU is required: the v0.1 replaceable TPU limit bumpers were replaced by rigid PET-G stops printed into the chassis towers and rockers.
Revision A (prototype-v0.1.json) is kept for the v0.1 package.
